name: JM Owner Vault
purpose: Add explicit private durable owner storage behind the existing local-first Owner Room without turning private custody into public publication.

storage.stored_bodies: standalone HTML bytes explicitly synced by the owner
storage.snapshot_rule: metadata/state snapshots do not duplicate HTML object bytes

laws: Nothing uploads without an explicit owner Sync or Save private revision action
Private durable copy is not public publication
Identical bytes are not identical identity: every independently intended body use is preserved
Only exact same-source-instance and same-bytes retries are idempotent
No older intended body is silently evicted at index capacity
Every private source edit produces a separately preserved revision with a source hash and a new ID

security_boundary.session_auth: X-JM-Owner-Key entered by the owner and held only in browser sessionStorage
security_boundary.future_upgrade: Cloudflare Access identity/JWT gate may replace the session key without changing the storage contract

publication_boundary: R2 owner-vault objects remain private working custody. Deliberate promotion to a canonical public repository body continues through the governed permanent HTML body pipeline and separate deployment proof.

current_source_policy.source_instance_identity: Existing local mounted-body id; preserves separate intended uses even with identical HTML bytes, name and filename
current_source_policy.edit_revision: Same mounted-body id with changed bytes appends a new version; previousVersionId links the ancestor
current_source_policy.legacy_missing_source_id: Preserve as a distinct record; do not deduplicate by hash alone
current_source_policy.body_bytes_storage: Separate R2 object per distinct intended use; no physical deduplication of separately purposeful copies

private_source_editor.placement: Existing Estate Owner Room / JM Owner Vault (not a new app)
private_source_editor.action: Explicit Save private revision & verify readback
private_source_editor.auth: Existing session-scoped owner key; no new credentials
private_source_editor.revision: Immutable new HTML R2 object with previousVersionId and stable use identity
private_source_editor.verification: Server hash + independent authenticated GET/readback checked against submitted HTML; no public deployment implied
private_source_editor.permanence_boundary: Private server-backed owner storage, not automatic public code or deployed app editing

device_recovery.boundary: Existing Owner Room local shelf, no new front door
device_recovery.action: Explicit RESTORE TO DEVICE of private HTML version
device_recovery.integrity: Downloaded bytes SHA-256 verified against private metadata before local commit
device_recovery.no_reupload: Restored local copy carries vaultBodyId, and ordinary Sync excludes those readback copies
device_recovery.no_loss: Local quota exceptions cannot erase original in-memory or persisted shelf
device_recovery.full_shelf: 12-body cap refuses import without evicting existing bodies
device_recovery.provenance: Local copy has independent local ID plus vaultBodyId, sourceInstanceId, SHA-256 and previousVersionId
device_recovery.live_proof: Source and synthetic phone/desktop browser proof PASS; public deployed Owner Room code proof PASS via recorded GitHub live receipt; real owner-key save/reload/recovery NOT proved.

owner_auth_proof.scope: Existing Owner Room; single explicit owner-initiated temporary HTML private test
planned_gates: temporary isolated private R2 write and immediate SHA-256 readback
actual page reload followed by independent authenticated readback
delete only exact temporary ID after content identity gate
manifest absence check and exportable JSON receipt
owner_auth_proof.mutation_boundary: Only random CP08 temporary body after owner press; no original JM creations read or modified
owner_auth_proof.no_duplicate: A pending checkpoint must never replay a possibly committed upload; use exact private index readback
owner_auth_proof.receipt: Browser-local verified receipt can be exported; no owner secret is stored or placed in GitHub
owner_auth_proof.real_owner_proof_status: HOLD until owner clicks test on production under their own private authenticated session

gates: source code committed independently in GitHub
private API contract and synthetic owner UI/browser checks passed
deployed original Owner Room source verified
holds: independent editability of all Estate creations
